Package com.csse3200.game.cards

Class CardDiscoveryService

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.cards.CardDiscoveryService
public class CardDiscoveryService extends Object

    • replaceProgress

      public void replaceProgress(Map<String,CardUnlockState> restoredProgress)
      Atomically replaces discovery progress using stable card IDs.

      Entries omitted from the supplied map become locked. Unknown but well-formed card IDs are ignored so saves remain loadable when definitions change between versions.

    • mergeProgress

      public void mergeProgress(Map<String,CardUnlockState> incoming)
      Merges discovery progress using stable card IDs without downgrading existing progress.

      Unknown but well-formed card IDs are ignored so persisted progress remains loadable when definitions change between versions.

      Parameters:
      incoming - progress to merge into the current state
